description: Which BT ids (and which projected truth values) result from BETWEEN with a Null bound on each side and both, NOT BETWEEN and NOT (...) with a Null bound, a Null left operand, Long against Text bounds ('5', '1' and '5'), Text against Long bounds, Date against Long serial bounds and against Text date bounds, expression bounds, the column itself as both bounds, a column as one bound, AND/OR following the BETWEEN, and subquery bounds? Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text is opened as a snapshot with Database.OpenRecordset, Fields Name/Type/Size are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
retentionNote: Designed r-sql-13b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
